description.value: Threefold is a brewery collective on Powell Street in East Vancouver, bringing three independent craft breweries together under one roof alongside Neapolitan pizza. The taproom pours a rotating tap list of craft beers and other drinks, with a food menu that gives cyclists the chance to sample multiple local producers in a single stop. The menu includes a wide range of vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options alongside more conventional fare.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active brewery collective at 1507 Powell Street, Vancouver, corroborating the OSM street address but contradicting the OSM community field of 'North Vancouver' (coordinates and V5L postal code both place this in Vancouver proper). Takeout is confirmed by 'Order Takeout' and 'To-Go List' navigation items on the website. Vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options are confirmed by explicit menu labels (vg), (v), and (g/f) across multiple pizza, snack, and dessert items. No evidence exists on the website or in OSM tags for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging amenities.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'North Vancouver' but coordinates (49.2833, -123.0740) and postal code V5L place this in Vancouver (East Vancouver); the website also confirms 'Vancouver'.
OSM name is 'Threefold Brewery' but the website brands the venue simply as 'Threefold' and describes it as 'A brewery collective' rather than a single brewery.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active brewery collective with food service, takeout, and inclusive menu options; a solid refuelling stop for touring cyclists passing through East Vancouver.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Multiple menu items explicitly labelled (vg) vegetarian, (v) vegan, and (g/f) gluten-free across pizzas, snacks, and desserts, e.g. Vegan Hawaiian pizza, Castelvetrano olives (v)(g/f), Vegan Ice Cream (v)(g/f)
